title: MARTEN TRANSPORT DECLARES QUARTERLY DIVIDEND
summary: MONDOVI, Wis., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Marten Transport, Ltd. (Nasdaq/GS:MRTN) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share of common stock. The dividend will be payable on December 30, 2026 to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 16, 2026. This is Marten’s 66th consecutive quarterly cash dividend.
